question: What is the revenue from delivered orders that received at least one 5-star review?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
reviewed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.order_id
    FROM reviews r
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
)
SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN delivered d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
JOIN reviewed r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
plan: • Identify delivered orders where order_status = 'delivered' in orders. • Join reviews on order_id and keep orders that have at least one review with review_score = 5. • Join order_items to those orders and compute revenue as price + freight_value for each item. • Sum the revenue across all qualifying items to get the total revenue.
